prompts.label: direct invocation
prompts.prompt: Run ep-audit on this TypeScript monorepo. Do not fix source.

prompts.label: implied need
prompts.prompt: Find architecture, boundary, and duplication violations and write action items under docs/audit/.

prompts.label: category subset
prompts.prompt: Only check imports and dry. Pause after findings.md.

prompts.label: interrupted run
prompts.prompt: Resume today's audit. findings.md is incomplete.

prompts.label: plan only
prompts.prompt: I edited findings.md. Re-run only the plan phase of ep-audit.

prompts.label: types and errors
prompts.prompt: Scan for any, swallowed errors, and testability issues. Discovery only.

prompts.label: styling
prompts.prompt: Audit inline styles and raw colour literals. Don't change components.

prompts.label: ambiguous wording
prompts.prompt: Produce the engineering-principles finding files for this repo.

prompts.label: setup not audit
prompts.prompt: Write AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for this new repo.

prompts.label: layout review
prompts.prompt: Is this package layout the right architecture? Suggest alternatives.

prompts.label: advice only
prompts.prompt: Explain what a boundary violation is. Don't scan the repo.

prompts.label: security audit
prompts.prompt: Run a security audit for XSS and SQL injection.

prompts.label: coverage report
prompts.prompt: Generate a test coverage report with vitest.

prompts.label: prettier
prompts.prompt: Format the whole repo with Prettier.

prompts.label: performance
prompts.prompt: Profile the API hot path and suggest caching.
